objective: GATE 1 R2 READ-ONLY SQL del frente Servidores + Conexiones + Comunicaciones + Robot Universal + Toast + Internacionalizacion. Reemision del mismo alcance tras bloqueo R1 por BASE_SHA_MISMATCH. Auditar esquema SQL canonico real antes de cualquier DDL: objetos existentes, columnas/tipos, PK/FK, indices, relaciones, conteos y estructuras relacionadas/reutilizables. No leer valores de secretos, no ejecutar DML/DDL y no modificar repositorio ni Produccion. El resultado debe registrar el base_sha real observado por el Worker al ejecutar.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: canonical_objects_exact
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: related_objects_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (200) s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Conexion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Servidor%' OR o.name LIKE '%Software%' OR o.name LIKE '%Version%' OR o.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sync%' OR o.name LIKE '%Homolog%' OR o.name LIKE '%Credencial%' OR o.name LIKE '%Secreto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Turno%' OR o.name LIKE '%Idioma%' OR o.name LIKE '%Locale%' OR o.name LIKE '%Moneda%' OR o.name LIKE '%Pais%' OR o.name LIKE '%Timezone%' OR o.name LIKE '%ZonaHoraria%' OR o.name LIKE '%Layout%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evidencia%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ejecucion%' OR o.name LIKE '%External%' OR o.name LIKE '%Externo%') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: columns_for_target_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity, c.is_computed, dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: primary_unique_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, kc.name AS constraint_name, kc.type_desc, ic.key_ordinal, c.name AS column_name FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=kc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=o.object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') ORDER BY o.name,kc.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: foreign_keys_target_objects
queries.sql: SELECT sch1.name AS parent_schema, obj1.name AS parent_table, fk.name AS fk_name, col1.name AS parent_column, sch2.name AS referenced_schema, obj2.name AS referenced_table, col2.name AS referenced_column, fk.is_disabled, fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.objects obj1 ON obj1.object_id=fk.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch1 ON sch1.schema_id=obj1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns col1 ON col1.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND col1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.objects obj2 ON obj2.object_id=fk.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas sch2 ON sch2.schema_id=obj2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns col2 ON col2.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND col2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE obj1.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') OR obj2.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') ORDER BY parent_table,fk_name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: indexes_target_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique_constraint, i.has_filter, i.filter_definition, ic.key_ordinal, ic.is_included_column, c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=i.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') AND i.index_id>0 ORDER BY o.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: target_table_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.index_id IN (0,1) THEN p.rows ELSE 0 END) AS row_count FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion','Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') GROUP BY s.name,o.name ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: candidate_secret_columns_metadata_only
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (c.name LIKE '%secret%' OR c.name LIKE '%password%' OR c.name LIKE '%token%' OR c.name LIKE '%credential%' OR c.name LIKE '%credencial%' OR c.name LIKE '%encrypted%' OR c.name LIKE '%cifrad%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: internationalization_columns_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (200) s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (c.name LIKE '%timezone%' OR c.name LIKE '%zona_horaria%' OR c.name LIKE '%pais%' OR c.name LIKE '%country%' OR c.name LIKE '%moneda%' OR c.name LIKE '%currency%' OR c.name LIKE '%idioma%' OR c.name LIKE '%language%' OR c.name LIKE '%locale%' OR c.name LIKE '%fx%' OR c.name LIKE '%tipo_cambio%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: external_ids_execution_evidence_columns_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (200) s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (c.name LIKE '%external%' OR c.name LIKE '%externo%' OR c.name LIKE '%provider%' OR c.name LIKE '%execution%' OR c.name LIKE '%ejecucion%' OR c.name LIKE '%evidence%' OR c.name LIKE '%evidencia%' OR c.name LIKE '%sync_run%' OR c.name LIKE '%layout%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: duplicate_named_objects_across_schemas
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 GROUP BY o.name HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY occurrences DESC,o.name
